arguments.html:
Resolve status disagreements before implementation
R3’s Watches catalogue labels offline and uncertain-save behavior Produced. R4’s retained catalogue 8M0-0 marks local queue/write-path bindings GAP. Preserve both dated records; verify the existing watch owner. Do not infer that offline behavior was removed, silently retry an uncertain save, or treat unreadable storage as a confirmed empty account. R3’s historical supersession table is not an exhaustive inventory; R2 already contains a mobile Brief.

updates.html: Start with R2 journey map B9-0 and interpretation contract 4GX-0. R3/R4 and North Star remain identified studies. Legacy 90–94 stays on the archive page.

Bonds R33/transmission has a source-linked implementation candidate; earlier decision and pre-R30 studies remain distinct. Forex retains its measure, direction and gated-watch contracts. Crypto’s R4 scorecard replaces seven archived R3 boards while retaining historical R1/R2 behavior contracts.

Commodities’ R2 route map remains the recorded implementation reference. R3/R4 and North Star studies are not automatically adopted replacements. Preserve legacy allocation, relative-strength, source, recovery, negative-price and roll semantics until their exact disposition is established. Bounded reference verification is not production acceptance.
